candidate_workaround: Use raw JavaScript template literals or explicitly doubled backslashes for every Windows command and workdir path passed through an orchestration wrapper.
failure_signature: Two wrapper calls interpreted ordinary JavaScript backslash escapes and rejected their malformed workdir paths before any Git command began.
recurrence_guard: Construct Windows command and workdir strings with String.raw before dispatch and verify the resolved D-first directory read-only.
rollback: Retain each wrapper rejection at zero credit and leave the staged index untouched until a raw-path probe succeeds.
scope_boundary: Windows path transport through the local orchestration wrapper only.
title: Preserve Windows paths through raw wrapper literals
trigger_preconditions: A JavaScript wrapper sends a Windows path containing backslashes to PowerShell or the shell workdir field.
